text: Make the ShowError box red. Is there a path from Start to Dashboard?
Can you put a small yellow star above Lunch? Which shapes are to the right of Art?
Hey so Cfo should report to Board now, not Ceo. Move Cfo above Board, please. Then connect Board to Ceo with a plain line, thanks.
delete Cache. connect Api to Db. how many arrows are there now?
Move Pg right about 80 pixels, and make Sg green. Then connect Pg to Sf with a dashed arrow.

Hi, I'm reorganizing our sprint board and it got messy. First, the Backlog column is too tall, so could you shrink Backlog a bit? Second, the Blocked card should be red, I think that's what we agreed in standup. Hmm, actually no, make it orange, red is too alarming for a soft block. Then move Review to the right of Doing, since reviews happen right after the work. I want Done at the far right, so move it to the right side of the canvas. Connect Doing to Review and Review to Done as a chain. Is Blocked connected to anything right now? If it is, please label Blocked as "Waiting on vendor". Last thing, how many shapes are there in total?
Add a teal circle called Ethics under Thesis. Connect Ethics to Methods too. Which shape is the most connected one?
Move Kid below Mom. Is Grandma directly linked to Kid?

So I'm laying out a small apartment on the canvas and I need some help with it. The Kitchen is at the top left, which is fine. Move Bath to the right of Hall, because the plumbing is on that side. Bedroom should be big, make it huge please. Livingroom is kind of small right now, can you enlarge it a little? I'd like the Hall between Kitchen and Bedroom. Oh and the balcony, I'll draw that myself later so don't add it. Is Bath bigger than Bedroom? Also make the Hall gray so it reads as a corridor. Then I want all the rooms arranged in a grid. How many rooms do we have now? If Bedroom is not in the top right, move it there. Thanks a lot, this is getting nice.
Move the Logo to the top left. Then put the Search to its right. Make the Footer gray.
Connect Idle to Running and Running to Paused. Is there a cycle in this diagram?

We're drawing the production setup and I'm typing this between meetings so forgive the mess. Put Dns at the top center of the canvas. Alb should sit right below Dns. Then connect Alb to Web1 and Web2 with solid lines, nothing fancy. Oops, I meant Web1 and Web2 both go to Alb, the other way round, so the arrows point at Alb. Could you disconnect Alb from Dns? That link is wrong. Rds should be huge because it's the main database. Make Cache teal, the ops team likes teal for caches. Connect Web1, Web2 and Cache to Rds, all of them. Is Bucket linked to anything? Put Bucket at the bottom right corner. Move Cache a bit to the left, around 50 pixels. Is there a path from Dns to Bucket? Can you line the web servers up in a row? Thanks, reply when done.
Rename Stop to Halt please. Make the Halt box gray.
Undo that last move, I put it in the wrong place.
Hey, I'm making a board game map. Put the Castle in the top right corner. Connect Village to Castle with a dotted line. Is Forest bigger than River?

Our CI pipeline is a mess in the diagram and I want it clear before the review on Friday. Lint has to run first, then Test, then Build, then Deploy. Right now the arrows are all over the place. Please connect Lint, Test, Build and Deploy in a chain. Notify should happen after Deploy and it should be a dotted line since it is optional. Make Notify small. Then make it orange. Also rename Build to Compile because that's the actual name we use. Then put Deploy in the bottom right. Which shape is the leftmost one? Is there a path from Lint to Notify? Last thing, make 3 copies of Test, it runs in parallel.

I'm mapping out the pancake recipe as a diagram for my cooking class. Flour and Eggs both go into Mix, so connect them to Mix. Then connect Mix to Bake and Bake to Cool. Make Bake orange so the students see it is the hot step. Can you put Eggs above Flour? Then move Mix right by 60 pixels. I also want everything lined up in a row, left to right. Is there a path from Flour to Cool? How many steps are there in total? Also make Cool blue. Rename Mix to Batter because that is what it is called in the book. Thanks, and tell me if something looks off.
Connect Atom1 to Bond and Bond to Atom2. Is Bond between Atom1 and Atom2? Make Atom1 huge.
Can you add a square called Log under Db?
Swap Alpha and Beta, please. Thanks!
Hi, I'm a teacher making a seating chart. Move Desk3 to the left of Desk2. Put the Teacher at the top center. How many shapes are on the canvas?
Make a green circle called Goal to the right of Idea. Connect Goal to Sub1 and Sub2. Make Sub1 a square, not a circle. What is Idea connected to? Are Sub1 and Sub2 linked to each other?

We're planning a four bed ward and I want to check the layout before the architect meeting. Bed1 is by the window and that's correct. Move Bed2 next to Bed1, to its right. Bed3 should go between Bed1 and Door, hmm, no, between Bed2 and Door. Make the Sink tiny because it's a small wall unit. Make the Nurses station teal, that's our standard. Connect Nurses to Door with a dotted line. Which shape is closest to Door? Put Nurses in the middle of the room. Rename Door to Entrance, the facilities guys call it that. Which shape is the biggest? Can you list all the squares? Lastly undo the last move, it went too far.
Move Knight up 120 pixels. Does Pawn sit to the left of Bishop?
Connect Customer to Order and Order to Product. Make Product purple. Thanks!

Ok so we just moved offices and I'm sketching the new floor for the team, bear with me. The Lobby is at the bottom left corner and I want it to stay there. Put the Stairs between Lobby and Kitchen. Room1 and Room2 should be next to each other on the right side. Make Exit red so people notice it. Connect Lobby to Stairs, then Stairs to Kitchen, and Kitchen to Room1. Hmm, does Room2 need a link to Room1? Yes, link Room2 to Room1 with a dashed line, it's a glass wall. Delete Room2? No no, don't delete it, just resize Room2 larger. How big is Kitchen? Is Stairs left of Exit? Move Exit to the top right corner. Can you show me the shape with the most connections? Last, rename Lobby to Reception, that's what the sign says.
Move Ball right of Goal. Is Ball bigger than Goal?

Hi, team lead here, I'm documenting the nightly data job. Ingest comes first and it's the slow part. Clean should follow Ingest and Model should follow Clean, that's the normal order. Connect Ingest to Clean, Clean to Model, and then Model to Report. Archive should only get data from Report, not from Model. Can you disconnect Model from Archive if there's a link? Make the Alert a dotted diamond because it's only for failures. Hmm, I said dotted but actually make the Alert a red diamond, the dotted thing is confusing. Move Archive below Report. Which shape has the most connections right now? Last, count how many arrows there are in total.
I'm laying out my backyard vegetable garden. Put Basil right of Tomato. Make Shed brown. Path should go between Tomato and Shed. Could you draw a small green circle called Pond at the bottom left?
Mkae the Logo bigger pls. And waht shapes are above Logo?

Good morning, I'm setting up a small grocery store on this canvas as a training exercise for new staff. Move the Entrance to the bottom center, everyone walks in from there. Move Checkout near the Entrance. Shelf1, Shelf2 and Shelf3 run in parallel, so arrange those three in a row. Hmm, wait, the shelves should be in a column, not a row. So arrange those three in a column. Move Fridge to the far left so it is out of the way. Make the Fridge a blue square. Is Shelf2 between Shelf1 and Shelf3? Could you align Shelf1 and Shelf3 on the horizontal axis? Connect Entrance to Checkout. Customers flow from there to the exit, but there is no exit shape yet. Make the Checkout huge, it's the busiest spot. Which shape is the tiniest one? How many shelves are there in total? Thanks, I'll keep adding.
Which shape is the most connected? And is Printer linked to anything?

Lineup for our band on stage, I'm placing everyone before rehearsal. Put Drums at the top. Put Bass left of Drums. Put Guitar right of Drums. Move Vocals below Drums. Keys are behind Vocals. Make Vocals large so it's clear who's the singer. Is Keys above Vocals? Shift Keys to the right by 40 pixels. Connect Bass and Drums as a pair in the mix? No, skip that. Rename Stage to Riser, it's just a small platform. How many people are on stage? Which one is the leftmost?
Make a purple star named Vision to the left of Core. Then connect Vision to Core.
Undo that, please.
Which shape is farthest from Hub? Also show me how many arrows touch Hub. Thanks!
Conect Sensor to Relay with a dottd line. Then connect Relay to Motor. Is there a path from Sensor to Motor?

Hey, I'm making a retrospective board for our sprint review. Good is the column for things that went well and it's on the left. Put Bad on the right side of Good. Ideas and Actions go below both of them. I'd like Actions to be the biggest box so people notice. Make Actions huge then. Hmm, honest question, should Ideas be a diamond? No, leave it. Make Good green. Make Bad red please. Connect Ideas to Actions, the ideas turn into actions. Is Good above Ideas? Rename Bad to Problems, the team asked for that. What is the most connected shape? Thanks.
Move Physics below Chemistry. Count how many shapes are in the diagram.
Hi! My son drew this dinosaur world map. Make the Volcano red and move it to the top right. He will be so happy, thanks!
Connect Triage to Urgent and Normal. Is there a cycle in this flow? Delete the Closed shape if nobody uses it. What's the rightmost shape?

I run a small cafe and I'm drawing the seating map so the staff know where everyone sits. Door is at the bottom left and I can't move it. The Bar goes along the right wall, so move it to the right side. Table1 is next to the Door. Table2 and Table3 are farther back. Can you move Table3 above Table2? Make the Kitchen gray and large. Connect Kitchen to Bar with a dotted line, that's the waiter path. Which table is closest to Door? Lastly, make a new small circle named Plant near the Bar. Also count how many tables we have right now.
Set the Gk green. Line up Cb, Lb and Rb in a row. Move St to the top center. Is Cm between Cb and St? Thanks coach.
Make the Db orange. Add a square named Log near the Db.

Our product team is mapping the checkout flow and I need the diagram to be correct before we send it to design. Home goes to Search, and Search goes to Product, then Product goes to Cart. Connect Cart to Pay and Pay to Confirm. I think Confirm should be green, it's the happy path. Make Confirm green. Also make Pay huge. Is there a path from Home to Confirm? Let's also add a red box called Error, it's where failed payments go. Connect Pay to Error with a dashed line. Move Error below Pay. Which shape has the fewest connections? Could you arrange everything in a column so the flow reads top to bottom? Thanks, I'll review it after lunch.
Undo the last two things, I messed up.

I teach physics and I'm using the canvas to show Newton's second law for the class. Mass and Force both feed into Accel. Accel should be the highlighted one, so make it yellow. I'm not sure if Friction belongs in this diagram or not, let's see. Connect Friction to Force with a dotted line, because it opposes the force. Newton should sit above everything, put it on top. Actually no, I'd rather have Newton at the top left corner. Move Newton to top left. Is Mass the same size as Force? Can you check if Accel is larger than Force? Rename Accel to Acceleration, students don't know the abbreviation. Make the Mass small. Show me the list of all the circles. I think circles are for quantities. How many shapes are there? Thanks, you're really helpful.
Put a diamond called Decide under Router. Then connect Router to Decide. Is Decide red?

I'm making a board for a tabletop strategy game. Move the Board to the center, and I'll add the pieces around it. That's a lot of typing, so let's just create one circle named Piece1 at the bottom. Then duplicate Piece1 three times. I'm not sure the tool moves duplicates to the right, so skip that. Connect Board to Piece1. Which shapes are touching the Board? Make the Board teal. Anything not teal, make it gray. Which shape is the smallest? Undo the last step if the layout breaks. Thanks.

I'm drafting a storyboard for a five minute short film, the scenes are the boxes. Scene1 opens the film, so put it on the far left. Scene2 follows Scene1, and Scene3 follows Scene2. Connect them in a chain. Make Scene2 yellow because it's the twist. Credits should come last, so move Credits to the right of Scene3. Hmm, actually, put Credits at the bottom right corner, it doesn't really go after Scene3. Is there a path from Scene1 to Credits? Shrink Scene1, it's too big. Could you add a circle named Narration above Scene2? Rename Scene3 to Ending. Then list all the rectangles. Thanks, I think the story works now.
